app.name: BankShield AZ
app.notice: Compliance support tool. Not approved by the Central Bank of Azerbaijan. No regulatory content has been verified yet.

auth.loginDescription: Sign in with the account provided by your administrator.

auth.accessDeniedDescription: Your account does not have permission to open this page.

users.title: User administration
users.description: Create accounts, assign roles, and disable access. Role and account changes invalidate active sessions.
users.name: Name
users.passwordHint: Use at least 12 characters. Share it with the user through a secure channel.

errors.invalidInput: Check the submitted values and try again.
errors.userExists: An account with this email already exists.

regulatory.title: Regulatory Library
regulatory.description: Browse regulatory documents and requirements, view original clauses and labeled translations, and map requirements to controls.

audits.title: Audit Engagements
audits.description: Create engagements, select scope, and assess controls with full assessment history.

controls.title: Security Controls
controls.description: Maintain the control catalogue and human-reviewed links to regulatory requirements.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: Upload PDF and DOCX evidence to private storage, with hashing, local text extraction, and review.

aiReview.title: AI Review
aiReview.description: Review AI-suggested mappings, gaps, and draft findings. Every suggestion starts as pending and needs a human decision.

findings.title: Findings & Remediation
findings.description: Track findings, risk scores, remediation owners, deadlines, and completion evidence.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Generate traceable audit reports with limitations and evidence references, in Azerbaijani or English.

admin.title: Administration
admin.description: Manage users, roles, and the audit log.

regulatoryLibrary.description: Maintain source records, versions, and provision-level requirements. New records remain pending legal verification until a qualified reviewer records a decision.
regulatoryLibrary.noSources: No regulatory sources have been recorded.
regulatoryLibrary.noRequirements: No requirements have been recorded for this version.
regulatoryLibrary.pendingNotice: Only enter details confirmed from an authoritative record. Leave unknown dates, applicability, and clause wording blank. New sources, versions, and requirements always start pending legal verification.
regulatoryLibrary.lockedNotice: Version and requirement content can only be edited while pending verification. Once review starts, return it to pending with a review note before making corrections; verified content should be replaced by a new version.
regulatoryLibrary.noDeleteNotice: Records cannot be deleted in this interface. This protects sources and requirements referenced by audits; use a new version or mark a superseded record instead.

actions.statusUpdated: Verification status and review history updated.
actions.invalidInput: Some fields are invalid. Check the values and try again.
actions.duplicate: A source code, version label, or clause reference already exists.
actions.notFound: This record no longer exists. Refresh the page and try again.
actions.invalidTransition: That verification status transition is not allowed.
actions.recordLocked: This record is locked for editing in its current verification status.
actions.noTransition: No further status changes are available.

auditWorkflow.title: Audit engagements
auditWorkflow.description: Create and manage audit engagements, assign auditors, and select requirements for scope.
auditWorkflow.noEngagements: No audit engagements are available to your account yet.
auditWorkflow.noAuditors: No active Auditor accounts are available. An administrator must create or enable an Auditor account first.
auditWorkflow.notFound: This engagement is unavailable or you do not have access.
auditWorkflow.dataErrorBody: The application could not read engagement data. No records are shown; try again later or contact your system administrator.
auditWorkflow.noRequirements: No unselected regulatory requirements are available.
auditWorkflow.noSelectedRequirements: No requirements have been selected for this engagement.
auditWorkflow.unverifiedNotice: This requirement is not verified. Including it does not confirm its legal authority or applicability.
auditWorkflow.acknowledgeUnverified: I explicitly choose to include this unverified requirement for review; its legal status and applicability remain unconfirmed.
auditWorkflow.noAuditTrail: No activity has been recorded yet.

errors.invalidInput: Check the submitted values and try again.

errors.notFound: The engagement or selected record no longer exists.
errors.duplicate: This auditor or requirement is already assigned to the engagement.
errors.invalidTransition: That engagement status transition is not allowed.
errors.unverifiedDecision: Explicit acknowledgement and a decision note are required to include an unverified requirement.
errors.generic: The operation could not be completed. Try again or contact your system administrator.

success.requirementSelected: Requirement added to the engagement scope.

controlWorkflow.description: Manage control records and requirement mappings. A mapping is an internal rationale, not legal verification or a compliance conclusion.
controlWorkflow.search: Search code, title, domain, or description
controlWorkflow.noControls: No security controls have been recorded.
controlWorkflow.title: Control title
controlWorkflow.noMappings: No requirements are mapped to this control.
controlWorkflow.pendingVerificationNotice: Mapping does not verify or confirm the requirement. Its current verification status remains unchanged.
controlWorkflow.mappingHistoryNotice: Mappings are append-only in this interface. They are not deleted or silently propagated into existing engagement scopes; use current mappings when selecting a requirement in a new engagement.
controlWorkflow.dataErrorBody: The application could not read control data. No records are shown; try again later or contact your system administrator.

errors.invalidInput: Check the submitted values and try again.
errors.duplicateControl: A control with this code already exists.
errors.duplicateMapping: This requirement is already mapped to the control.
errors.notFound: The selected record no longer exists.
errors.invalidEvidence: Choose evidence from this engagement that is relevant to the selected control.
errors.approvalRejected: The assessment does not meet the approval requirements. It needs a tested status, reviewer justification, and evidence unless it is not applicable.
errors.invalidTransition: This assessment is approved or no longer current and cannot be changed in place.
errors.concurrentRevision: Another revision was saved at the same time. Reload the engagement and try again.

success.mapped: Requirement mapped. Its verification status was not changed.
success.assessmentSaved: A new assessment revision was recorded.
success.approved: Assessment approved and recorded in the audit history.

assessmentWorkflow.emptyScope: No mapped control scope items are available for assessment.
assessmentWorkflow.notApplicableReason: Reason the control is not applicable
assessmentWorkflow.evidence: Evidence records for this engagement and control
assessmentWorkflow.noEvidence: No eligible evidence record is available. Evidence upload/storage is not implemented in this phase.
assessmentWorkflow.evidenceHint: Select only evidence that supports this revision. Evidence files are not opened or served here.
assessmentWorkflow.noAssessmentEvidence: No evidence is linked to this assessment.
assessmentWorkflow.pendingRequirement: The regulatory requirement is not verified; this assessment does not verify its legal status or applicability.

errors.invalidInput: Check the submitted values and try again.
errors.duplicateControl: A control with this code already exists.
errors.duplicateMapping: This requirement is already mapped to the control.
errors.notFound: The assessment or engagement is unavailable.
errors.invalidEvidence: The selected evidence does not belong to this engagement or control.
errors.approvalRejected: Approval requires a tested assessment, reviewer justification, and linked evidence unless the status is not applicable.

errors.concurrentRevision: A concurrent revision was saved. Reload and try again.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Overview of regulatory verification and audit progress.
dashboard.dataNotice: Dashboard figures are read from the database. Empty counts mean no matching records are currently stored; they are not a compliance score. Some application modules are still under development.
dashboard.errorBody: The application could not read dashboard data. No counts are shown; try again later or contact your system administrator.
dashboard.emptySources: No regulatory sources are stored in the database yet.
dashboard.sourcesNote: Retrieved through an automated summarizer. A named human reviewer must check each source against the official record before any requirement counts toward compliance metrics.
